What is the slope of the trend line shown above.
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that the trend line passes through the points $({x}_{1},{y}_{1})=(4,1)$ and $({x}_{2},{y}_{2})=(8,9).$

Therefore, we compute the slope $m$ of the line, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}m & =\frac{{y}_{2}-{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}-{x}_{1}} \\  & =\frac{9-1}{8-4} \\  & =\frac{8}{4} \\  & =2\end{aligned}
$$
